name: Entity IO Push
description: Provides functionality to push JSON data to configured servers using Basic Auth.
project_description: Submodule of Entity IO. Adds a 'Deploy' tab to node/comment/term/user/media/block entities to push the entity and its related content as JSON to another configured Drupal site over HTTP Basic Auth, and exposes a receiver endpoint that imports pushed JSON into the local site. Remote servers (URL, user, password, headers) are configured on a settings form; a dedicated 'receive JSON' permission (restricted) gates the importer endpoint.
